findings.quote: Simply subtracting the speeds as 2 − 1 = 1 m/s ignores that the two velocities are opposite in direction.
findings.note: Reader-facing text must be plain textbook English without the word "simply", which tells the student the step is easy instead of describing it.
findings.fix: Subtracting the speeds as 2 − 1 = 1 m/s ignores that the two velocities point in opposite directions.
